R1b_akshay_mail_logged_by_zoya.quote: capture STEP 1: 'except that such a row of Kind Email in, created since 2026-11-01 12:00 JST, without a "capture:" line ... gets that line'
R1b_akshay_mail_logged_by_zoya.scenario: PLAUSIBLE: it depends on whether Zoya's routine logs mail it's Cc'd on. Zoya is in Cc on every ad@ mail to outsiders (decision 225). Akshay replies to a PR from ad@ at 10:10: 'go ahead, record'. If Zoya's 10:38 run logs that message first (Kind Email out, not 'Zoya sent'), capture at 11:02 finds the key and doesn't stamp it, because it isn't Email in. Actions holds W for 2 hours, then passes it unworked. STEP 2b (Send draft moves, his answer taking him off his list) and STEP 3's 'Akshay decides' never fire. STEP 0 class 2 does stamp Email out, so the two steps disagree.
R1b_akshay_mail_logged_by_zoya.fix: Make the STEP 1 exception 'a row of Kind Email in, or Email out sent by Akshay or a Team member other than Zoya, ... never a row whose Summary starts "Zoya sent"'. Before cutover, check one row on Notion to see whether Zoya's routine logs Cc'd mail at all.

A1_late_stamp_lost.quote: actions STEP 1: 'plus rows created before 2026-11-02 and Captured on or after the day before W's date' + 'created under 2 hours ago ... still holds W'
A1_late_stamp_lost.scenario: MCP Emails hits quota from 10:00 to 14:00, so capture's runs end Failed and stamp nothing. Zoya, on her own connector, logs 'Priya to Zoya: confirms 14 Nov' (in ad@ too) at 10:38. Actions' hold expires at 12:38 and W moves past the row. At 15:02 capture stamps it, but the row is older than W minus 2 minutes and was created after 2 Nov, so no branch selects it. It's never worked.
A1_late_stamp_lost.fix: When capture's STEP 1 stamps a row, it also sets Captured today (with a 'first captured' line), and actions' Captured branch becomes 'created before 2026-11-02, or Captured on or after the day before W's date and created before W'. Another option is to make the hold 'until capture's newest record that has a read to has a read to past the row's created time' instead of 2 hours. Actions has only 837 bytes left, so keep it to one clause.

R3b_outage_marks_healthy_rows_stuck.quote: 'Before starting a row, add the body line "actions: try <n> <run id>" ...; a row that already has 3 gets "actions: stuck <why>"'
R3b_outage_marks_healthy_rows_stuck.scenario: A 3-hour MCP Emails outage: each run writes a try line on the oldest row, fails its THREAD read and ends Failed. After 3 runs a healthy row is stuck, is never worked again, and lands on For Akshay. Being stuck is permanent.
R3b_outage_marks_healthy_rows_stuck.fix: Count a try only from a run that didn't end Failed, or tell runs to remove their try line when they end Failed on a connector error ('a connector error is never a try').

N_cursor_wording.quote: CURSOR: 'the newest record with Source ID run:inbox-capture: (none yet: run:inbox:...)' vs STEP 1: '...run:inbox-capture: that has one, else run:inbox:'
N_cursor_wording.scenario: Minor. Suppose capture records exist but none has a read to, because every run failed in STEP 1. CURSOR picks the newest capture record, which has no read to, while STEP 1 falls back to the old inbox. The re-read that follows is bounded and safe.
N_cursor_wording.fix: Make CURSOR say 'that has a read to' too.

verdict: Close, but not accepted. R1 (for Zoya's sends), R2, R3, R4 and should-fix items 1 to 8 pass, and every earlier closed item (B1 to B10, S3, S5 to S9, D1 to D9) still passes. Two new holes come from the round 4 joins. A1 (blocking): a stamp capture writes more than 2 hours late, during an outage or a backlog, has no route back into actions, because the Captured branch now covers only rows created before 2 Nov. R1b (blocking if Zoya logs mail she's Cc'd on): the 'Kind Email in' limit leaves Akshay's own sent mail unworked when her run logs it first. R3b should be fixed too, since an outage can mark healthy rows stuck for good. Each fix is one clause; actions has 837 bytes left. Replay A1, R1b and R3b after the fix.
